wins.label: Strong operational growth despite STELARA loss of exclusivity
wins.evidence: delivered strong operational sales growth of 4.2% across our business...No other health care company has delivered growth through the first year of losing exclusivity for a multibillion-dollar product

wins.label: DARZALEX exceptional performance and expansion
wins.evidence: DARZALEX continues to set the standard in multiple myeloma with another quarter of over 20% growth...expanded our DARZALEX indication in Europe with the approval of DARZALEX-based quadruplet regimen

wins.label: RYBREVANT plus Lazcluze breakthrough efficacy data
wins.evidence: Phase III data presented at ELCC last month showing RYBREVANT plus Lazcluze extended overall survival by more than 1 year versus the current standard of care in first-line EGFR-mutated lung cancer

wins.label: TREMFYA rapid IBD market penetration
wins.evidence: TREMFYA is the fastest-growing product in the ulcerative colitis market...TREMFYA has already achieved nearly a 50% share of the IL-23 new patient starts in UC

wins.label: Guidance raised with $700M addition from CAPLYTA acquisition
wins.evidence: increasing our operational sales guidance for the full year by $700 million to reflect the addition of CAPLYTA following the completion of the intracellular acquisition

risks.label: STELARA biosimilar erosion accelerating throughout 2025
risks.evidence: we maintain the assumption that the impact of STELARA biosimilar competition will accelerate throughout the year, similar to HUMIRA's erosion curve

risks.label: Tariff headwinds of $400 million in 2025
risks.evidence: what's included in the $400 million...It includes the China tariffs as well as the China retaliatory tariff...That $400 million...is going to sit on the balance sheet in inventory

risks.label: Orthopedics underperformance with competitive pressures
risks.evidence: Orthopedics declined 3.1%, primarily driven by the lapping of a onetime revenue recognition timing change...partially offset by success of new product launches

risks.label: MedTech margin compression from recent acquisitions
risks.evidence: MedTech margin declined from 26.4% to 25.9%, primarily driven by R&D and selling, marketing and administrative investments associated with the recent acquisition of Shockwave and V-Wave

risks.label: Part D redesign creating ongoing pricing pressure
risks.evidence: Part D redesign, which is exclusively priced, which is eroding margin...The impact of Part D redesign on effective products as a percent of sales will be consistently applied throughout the year
